settings.title: Settings
settings.contentProcessingDesc: Configure how documents and URLs are processed
settings.doclingDesc: Docling is a little slower but more accurate, specially if the documents contain tables and images.
settings.simpleDesc: Simple will extract any content from the document without formatting it. It's ok for simple documents, but will lose quality in complex ones.
settings.autoDocDesc: Auto (recommended) will try to process through docling and default to simple.
settings.firecrawlDesc: Firecrawl is a paid service (with a free tier), and very powerful.
settings.jinaDesc: Jina is a good option as well and also has a free tier.
settings.simpleUrlDesc: Simple will use basic HTTP extraction and will miss content on javascript-based websites.
settings.autoUrlDesc: Auto (recommended) will try to use firecrawl (if API Key is present). Then, it will use Jina until reaches the limit (or will keep using Jina if you setup the API Key). It will fallback to simple, when none of the previous options is possible.
settings.embeddingHelpDesc: Embedding the content will make it easier to find by you and by your AI agents. If you are running a local embedding model (Ollama, for example), you shouldn't worry about cost and just embed everything. For online providers, you might want to be careful only if you process a lot of content (like 100s of documents at a day).
settings.embeddingAlwaysDesc: Choose always if you are running a local embedding model or if your content volume is not that big
settings.embeddingAskDesc: Choose ask if you want to decide every time
settings.embeddingNeverDesc: Choose never if you don't care about vector search or do not have an embedding provider.
settings.embeddingCostDesc: As a reference, OpenAI's text-embedding-3-small costs about 0.02 for 1 million tokens -- which is about 30 times the Wikipedia page for Earth. With Gemini API, Text Embedding 004 is free with a rate limit of 1500 requests per minute.
settings.fileManagementDesc: Configure file handling and storage options
settings.autoDeleteHelpDesc: Once your files are uploaded and processed, they are not required anymore. Most users should allow Open Notebook to delete uploaded files from the upload folder automatically. Choose no, ONLY if you are using Notebook as the primary storage location for those files (which you shouldn't be at all). This option will soon be deprecated in favor of always downloading the files.
settings.autoDeleteYesDesc: Choose yes (recommended) to automatically delete uploaded files after processing
settings.autoDeleteNoDesc: Choose no only if you need to keep the original files in the upload folder

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.subtitle: Advanced tools and utilities for power users
advanced.unableToCheckUpdates: Unable to check for updates. GitHub may be unreachable.
advanced.rebuildEmbeddingsDesc: Rebuild vector embeddings for your content. Use this when switching embedding models or fixing corrupted embeddings.
advanced.existingDesc: Re-embed only items that already have embeddings (faster, for model switching)
advanced.allDesc: Re-embed existing items + create embeddings for items without any (slower, comprehensive)
advanced.selectAtLeastOne: Please select at least one item type to rebuild
advanced.runningDesc: You can leave this page as this will run in the background
advanced.switchingModels: Switching embedding models: If you change from one embedding model to another, you need to rebuild all embeddings to ensure consistency.
advanced.upgradingVersions: Upgrading model versions: When updating to a newer version of your embedding model, rebuild to take advantage of improvements.
advanced.fixingCorrupted: Fixing corrupted embeddings: If you suspect some embeddings are corrupted or missing, rebuilding can restore them.
advanced.afterBulkImports: After bulk imports: If you imported content without embeddings, use "All" mode to embed everything.
advanced.localModels: Local models (Ollama): Very fast, limited only by hardware
advanced.cloudApis: Cloud APIs (OpenAI, Google): Moderate speed, may hit rate limits with large datasets
advanced.sourcesSlower: Sources: Slower than notes/insights (creates multiple chunks per source)
advanced.rebuildExample: Example: Rebuilding 200 items might take 2-5 minutes with cloud APIs, or under 1 minute with local models.
advanced.isSafeRebuild: Is it safe to rebuild while using the app?
advanced.yesRebuildSafe: Yes, rebuilding is safe! The rebuild process:
advanced.idempotent: Is idempotent: Running multiple times produces the same result
advanced.doesntDeleteContent: Doesn't delete content: Only replaces embeddings
advanced.canRunAnytime: Can be run anytime: No need to stop other operations
advanced.handlesErrorsGracefully: Handles errors gracefully: Failed items are logged and skipped
advanced.largeRebuildsWarning: However: Very large rebuilds (1000s of items) may temporarily slow down searches while processing.
